decision: Generated artifact specs support explicit write modes. protected_block mode updates a governed block inside an existing file for incremental migration, while full_file mode lets a generated artifact own the entire output path once the source specs and projection graph are mature enough. README.md demonstrates protected_block mode through GROUNDED-DOC-001; full_file generation remains available for mature documentation pages.
name: Support full-file generated document ownership
description: Documents generated document write modes so Grounded can migrate safely from protected generated blocks to fully generated documentation files.
